Membership.title: Membership Levels
Membership.slogan1: One Member • One Responsibility • One Prosperous India
Membership.commitment: Rashtriya Annadata Vikas Party is committed to providing a transparent, simple, and technology-driven membership system that enables every citizen to participate in nation building through organized public service. We are dedicated to building a strong membership base driven by responsibility, integrity, and public service.

Referral.title: Referral System
Referral.description: Every registered member receives a unique Referral Code. While registering, a new member may optionally enter the Referral Code of the person who invited them. The referring member will be able to monitor their referral performance from the Member Dashboard.

OrganizationStructure.title: Organization Structure
OrganizationStructure.meta_title: Organization Structure | Rashtriya Annadata Vikas Party
OrganizationStructure.meta_description: Explore the organizational structure of Rashtriya Annadata Vikas Party, from national leadership to state, district, taluka, city and village-level organizations.
OrganizationStructure.hero_description: Building a disciplined, transparent and people-driven organizational network from the national level to every village.
OrganizationStructure.intro_p1: Rashtriya Annadata Vikas Party believes that the greatest strength of any political party is a strong, responsible, disciplined, and continuously connected organization.
OrganizationStructure.intro_p2: An organization is not merely a structure of positions and designations. It is an active team that works on the principles of public service, discipline, transparency, accountability, and responsibility.
OrganizationStructure.intro_p3: Our organization will be developed through a multi-level structure reaching every State, District, Taluka, City, Ward, and Village of the country so that every citizen receives an equal opportunity to connect with the party and participate in the process of development.
OrganizationStructure.intro_p4: We firmly believe that only through a strong organization can the issues of the people be understood effectively, meaningful policies be formulated, and democracy be strengthened.
OrganizationStructure.vision_subheading: A nationwide organization that empowers every level of society.

nationwide.title: Nationwide Presence
nationwide.description: Work actively in every corner of the country.

service.title: Public Service First
service.description: Give the highest priority to serving citizens.

opportunity.title: Equal Opportunity
opportunity.description: Provide every member a fair opportunity to participate and lead.

inclusive.title: Inclusive Representation
inclusive.description: Provide leadership opportunities to youth, women, farmers, traders and professionals.

modern.title: Modern Organization
modern.description: Adopt technology-driven and modern working methods.

OrganizationStructure.hierarchy_heading: From National Leadership to Every Village
OrganizationStructure.hierarchy_subheading: Our multi-level structure connects national strategy with grassroots public service.

national.label: 01 • National Level
national.heading: National Leadership
national.description: At the national level, the National Executive will be responsible for policy formulation, organizational expansion, strategic planning, and coordination across the country.

state.label: 02 • State Level
state.heading: State Organization
state.description: In every state, the State Organization will implement the policies of the party while considering local circumstances, regional priorities, and the needs of the people.

district.label: 03 • District Level
district.heading: District Organization
district.description: The District Organization will be responsible for membership registration, public engagement, coordination of local issues, and organization of party programs and campaigns.

taluka.label: 04 • Taluka Level
taluka.heading: Taluka Organization
taluka.description: The Taluka Organization will serve as the primary coordination center between villages and the district organization.

city.label: 05 • City Level
city.heading: City & Ward Organization
city.description: In urban areas, the City Organization will manage party activities, membership registration, public outreach, and coordination at the ward level.

village.label: 06 • Village Level
village.heading: The Heart of Our Organization
village.description: The Village Organization will be one of the most important units of the party. It will maintain direct engagement with local citizens and will work on local issues, membership registration, public welfare initiatives, and development-oriented activities.

OrganizationStructure.wings_subheading: Dedicated platforms representing and empowering different sections of society.
OrganizationStructure.journey_heading: Your Journey from Member to Leadership
OrganizationStructure.journey_description: Every member receives an equal opportunity to progress through performance, commitment, discipline, leadership ability, and service to the people.
principles: Compliance with the Constitution and Law
OrganizationStructure.tech_description: To ensure effective and modern organizational management, the party will increasingly adopt technology-based systems.
OrganizationStructure.commitment_p1: The organization of Rashtriya Annadata Vikas Party will not merely be a hierarchy of office bearers. It will be a living and active family of dedicated workers committed to the overall development of the nation.
OrganizationStructure.commitment_p2: We are committed to building an organization where every member is respected, every worker receives an equal opportunity to develop as a leader, and every decision is guided by public interest, transparency, accountability, and democratic principles.
OrganizationStructure.motto_secondary: “Our workers are our greatest strength, and public service is our highest duty.”
